control_need.evidence: I'm doing this on my own terms this time.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: My mind and body just weren't in sync, and that's dangerous in this sport.

trust_propensity.evidence: Nobody stepped up. Not USA Gymnastics, not the USOPC, not the FBI.

risk_appetite.evidence: I'd rather regret going for it than regret playing it safe.

self_efficacy.evidence: I'm not perfect, but I work harder than anyone in that gym.

autonomy_need.evidence: At this point I have nothing to prove to anyone but myself.

intimacy_need.evidence: I love my husband, I love my dogs, and I love that I have a life outside the gym now.

status_sensitivity.evidence: The GOAT thing? I let my gymnastics do the talking.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: I don't want another young athlete to experience the horror that I and so many others have endured.

core_models.name: 身心同步安全阈值
core_models.rule: 当身体与心智不同步时，继续=危险，退出=理性；安全高于成绩
evidence: You have to be there 100 percent, or you can get very, very hurt.
My mind and body just weren't in sync, and that's dangerous in this sport.

core_models.name: 自我参照坐标系
core_models.rule: 以自己而非他人为竞争与评价基准，成就归于自我定义
evidence: I don't compete against other people. I compete against myself.
I'm not the next Usain Bolt or Michael Phelps. I'm the first Simone Biles.

core_models.name: 系统问责而非个体归罪泛化
core_models.rule: 失职被追溯至制度与多方，愤怒指向系统而非无差别扩散
evidence: I blame Larry Nassar, and I also blame an entire system that enabled and perpetuated his abuse.
I don't ever want to place blame anywhere it doesn't belong, but the failures were institutional.

core_models.name: 脆弱即智慧的重构
core_models.rule: 示弱/休息不是失败，而是自我保护与力量的表现
evidence: I used to think being strong meant never showing weakness. I was wrong.
Put mental health first, because if you don't, you're not going to enjoy your sport.

core_models.name: 为后来者发声的代际责任
core_models.rule: 个人行动的意义在于保护未来的人，而非只为自己
evidence: I sit before you today to raise my voice so that no little girl must endure what I did.
I want girls who look like me to know they belong on that podium.

heuristics.if: 身心不同步或有受伤风险
heuristics.then: 退出并优先保护身体与心智
heuristics.evidence: I didn't want to risk a medal for the team, and I didn't want to risk myself either.
I go out there and I do me.

heuristics.then: 克制而精确地点名多方
heuristics.evidence: We have been failed, and we deserve answers.
Not every day is easy, and that's okay.

heuristics.then: 让表现说话，拒绝自我吹嘘
heuristics.evidence: The GOAT thing? I let my gymnastics do the talking.

heuristics.then: 以「为自己/on my own terms」为动机框架
heuristics.evidence: When I came back, it wasn't for the medals. It was for me.

heuristics.then: 选择说出口而非继续掩埋
heuristics.evidence: It took me years to even say the words out loud.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 倡导「把心理健康放第一、可以休息」
internal_conflicts.force_b: 反复回归高压竞技并追求GOAT历史地位
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 东京退赛后仍于2024回归，但以「on my own terms / for me」重新包装动机来调和两股力量（dim-05言行不一记录）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 「我从不放弃任何事」的自我认同
internal_conflicts.force_b: 东京主动退出多项决赛
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头坚持never quit，行为上退赛——用「这是关于安全」重定义退出以保住不放弃的自我形象（"I never quit on anything in my life, but this was about safety."）
从『smiled through all of it』到『Some days I still wake up anxious』，公开叙事逐步撕开表演性坚强

internal_conflicts.force_b: 为团队/队友/后来者承担（empathy responsibility）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 既说『nothing to prove to anyone but myself』又强调『for the countless others』，在个人与代际责任间反复摆荡

emotion_triggers.trigger: 制度对受害者知情不报/失职
emotion_triggers.reaction: 克制但坚定的愤怒，精确点名
emotion_triggers.escalation: 从『We have been failed』升级至『Enough is enough.』与『the consequences will be swift and severe』

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被质疑抗压能力或被要求硬上场
emotion_triggers.reaction: 以安全与身心分裂为由划界
emotion_triggers.escalation: 从『I have to focus on my mental health』升级至『that's dangerous in this sport』/『you can get very, very hurt』

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被以他人标准或框架定义（如『下一个某某』/『养母』）
emotion_triggers.escalation: 从『I do me』升级至『I'm the first Simone Biles』
从『For the longest time I buried it』升级至『Tokyo was the moment everything I'd pushed down came crashing out』

blind_spots: 对『退赛=放弃团队/让队友失望』的外部感受回应不足，将其一律归入安全叙事 [保守派媒体评论员/体育专栏-2020s初]
品牌形象与『真实脆弱』叙事之间的商业化张力未被其自身正视 [文化评论/媒体分析-2020s]
顶级运动员『无论如何都上场』的传统期待被其重构为落伍，但可能低估此规范对团队体育文化的作用 [老派教练/评论文化-2010s-2020s]
幸存者证词的时序问题（『说得不够早』）被外界质疑，其自我叙事中较少处理 [少数辩护立场评论-2010s-2020s]
『借心理健康炒作/找借口』的公众怀疑被其直接否定而非深入回应 [社交平台匿名评论-2020s]

causal_rules.description: 高自主需求触发『为自己而非他人』的动机重构
causal_rules.disposition: 在重大决策中主动以『on my own terms / for me』框定，拒绝外部动机归因
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 2024回归、退赛后复出均以自我导向叙事包装（dim-05决策一、四）

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能与低不确定容忍并存时，倾向以安全阈值切断风险而非硬撑
causal_rules.disposition: 当结果不可控（twisties）时选择退出而非冒险
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 东京退赛：宁可放弃奖牌也不冒身心不同步之险

causal_rules.description: 低信任倾向遇制度失职即转为公开问责
causal_rules.disposition: 点名机构、要求答案，愤怒克制但指向系统
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 国会作证同时点名USAG/USOPC/FBI（dim-05决策三）

causal_rules.description: 高共情反应驱动代际保护型行动
causal_rules.disposition: 将个人创伤转化为『保护后来者』的公共倡议
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 公开作证与心理健康倡议均强调『for the countless others』/『the ones coming after』
